note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 ('Once the End-of-RIB marker for an address family is received from the peer, it MUST immediately remove any routes from the peer that are still marked as stale for that address family.') after commit 21587224da closed the prior multi-connection finding by tagging TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartEORDeletesEveryConnectionsStaleRoutes as positive. Single-restart behavior remains pinned by TestRFC4724EndOfRIBRemovesThatFamilysStaleRoutes (exact single purge-stale for IPv4 unicast), TestRFC4724EndOfRIBLeavesOtherFamiliesStale (no IPv6 or whole-peer purge; unretained family dispatches nothing), and TestGRStateManagerEORPurge / TestGRStateManagerEORForNonGRPeer. Consecutive-restart behavior is now proven end-to-end against the real registered RIB engine by TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartEORDeletesEveryConnectionsStaleRoutes: after connections 41 and 42 both leave stale routes retained in IPv4 unicast, End-of-RIB from connection 43 via handleEOREvent -> dispatchRetained immediately removes both connection 41's and connection 42's stale routes while keeping connection 43's refreshed route fresh.
